facts.fact: After a public outcry over interministerial arrete no. 015 of 20 July 2026 setting digital-sector duties, taxes and fees, the DRC digital economy minister held a working session with representatives of the digital ecosystem, including the Reseau des acteurs du numerique (RAN), reported by ACP on 7 August 2026 (meeting on the Thursday before, 6 August).
facts.system: Arrete interministeriel no. 015 du 20 juillet 2026 fixant les droits, taxes et redevances du secteur numerique

note: The agreed permanent dialogue framework and proposed sector barometer are only announced, not a body that has given an opinion, so no standing fact.
